items.title: P7 Topic High Relevance
items.abstract: P7 synthetic long-document QA. Sparse retrieval and cross-layer reranking improve grounding. We report EM gains of 2-4 points, but offline clustering adds latency.

items.title: P7 Special Shelf One
items.abstract: P7 synthetic survey. This survey compares retrieval and generation evaluation across problem, method, and evaluation layers. Graph gating may transfer to long-document reranking with a falsifiable experiment. Foundational benchmark work established the task.
